_categories.B3: fits with a log-derived sequence metric over the app's 'Data received' lines: received, lost, max_seq, last_gap_seq
_categories.B4: fits with all_of: several conditions satisfied in any order within one window
_categories.B5: needs a comparison between captured fields of one line (regex backreference or capture compare)
_categories.D: not an in-simulator assertion: real-time run whose verdict comes from an external driver process
